paper.title_en: Fingerprints of Individual Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Pulsar Timing Arrays
paper.abstract_en: With evidence for a nanoHertz gravitational-wave background now established by Pulsar Timing Arrays, the search focuses on identifying individual supermassive black hole binaries. We show that these binaries produce a distinct spatial correlation pattern across the array, acting as a deterministic analogue to the stochastic Hellings \& Downs curve. We derive a closed analytic expression for this single-source overlap reduction function, $Υ_{ab}$, factorizing the signal into a source-dependent amplitude and a purely geometric fingerprint. Using simulated datasets, we demonstrate that this fingerprint breaks the degeneracy between an individual binary and a stochastic background. Including these cross-correlations yields Bayes factors of $1611$ favoring the continuous-wave model over a Hellings \& Downs correlated background model and $159$ favoring the continuous-wave model over an uncorrelated red-noise model. Furthermore, these new cross-correlations improve sky localization by a factor of $11\times$ over an uncorrelated search. Finally, while coherent matched filtering offers higher theoretical sensitivity, we argue that a cross-correlation-based search for individual binaries provides a robust alternative that hedges against the possibility of overfitting to noise fluctuations by focusing on the evidence for the correlations. Indeed, the geometric fingerprints we present here show that spatial correlations can also be used to identify the first nanoHertz gravitational-wave sources.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文针对脉冲星计时阵列中单个超大质量双黑洞的识别，提出了独特的几何指纹方法，具有重要的理论和方法创新，符合PTA主题。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中单个超大质量双黑洞的指纹
decision.abstract_zh: 随着脉冲星计时阵列现已确立纳赫兹引力波背景的证据，搜索的重点转向识别单个超大质量双黑洞。我们证明，这些双星在阵列中产生一种独特的空间相关模式，作为随机Hellings & Downs曲线的确定性类似物。我们推导出这种单源重叠约化函数的闭合解析表达式$Υ_{ab}$，将信号分解为依赖源的振幅和纯几何指纹。利用模拟数据集，我们证明该指纹打破了单个双星与随机背景之间的简并性。包含这些互相关后，连续波模型相对于Hellings & Downs相关背景模型的贝叶斯因子为1611，相对于不相关红噪声模型的贝叶斯因子为159。此外，这些新的互相关将天空定位精度提高了不相关搜索的11倍。最后，虽然相干匹配滤波提供了更高的理论灵敏度，但我们认为基于互相关的单个双星搜索提供了一种稳健的替代方案，通过聚焦于相关性的证据来对冲过拟合噪声涨落的可能性。事实上，我们在此呈现的几何指纹表明，空间相关性也可用于识别首批纳赫兹引力波源。
